item.text: {"facts":[{"source_id":"SRC-77764738e56b9f19","start_unit":24,"end_unit":24,"fact_summary":"On 13 June 2023, a federal-government briefing reported that the Bund offered 97 of 115 Online Access Act services digitally and had largely fulfilled its federal obligations, while most services delivered by Länder and municipalities remained unavailable digitally across all of Germany. The government proposed amendments removing the written-form requirement, making user-friendliness and accessibility binding, providing central services such as a citizen account, and digitizing key federal services end-to-end within five years, including a proposed digital-only rule for business services.","question_ids":["4B.6","5B.6","6B.2","8B.1","8B.2","8B.6"],"polarity":"mixed","period_fit":"The report describes the federal government's position and implementation status in 2023.","ruler_attribution":"The measures are attributed to the Bundesregierung under Olaf Scholz's chancellorship; subnational implementation remained incomplete.","limitations":["The source is a parliamentary summary of a government briefing and does not independently evaluate service quality or nationwide outcomes."]},{"source_id":"SRC-c808f8c53f9a9f1d","start_unit":7,"end_unit":7,"fact_summary":"In a 7 March 2023 speech, Scholz stated that Germany had rapidly reduced dependence on Russian gas, oil, and coal; gas storage was nearly 70% full against a February target of 40%; and the government had used energy price brakes, an economic defense shield, new import capacity, and new energy partnerships.","question_ids":["5B.9","8B.1","8B.2","8B.3","8B.6","8B.9"],"polarity":"favorable","period_fit":"The speech reports conditions and measures during the 2022-2023 energy shock.","ruler_attribution":"Olaf Scholz explicitly attributed the outcomes to federal measures together with actions by citizens, companies, and municipal utilities.","limitations":["The performance claim is made by Scholz in a political speech and does not establish independent causal attribution."]},{"source_id":"SRC-c808f8c53f9a9f1d","start_unit":7,"end_unit":8,"fact_summary":"Scholz set or reaffirmed energy-transition targets including 80% renewable electricity by 2030, dedicating 2% of land to onshore wind, raising planned electrolyzer capacity to 10 gigawatts by 2030, installing 500,000 heat pumps annually from 2024, and making new LNG infrastructure hydrogen-compatible.","question_ids":["5B.1","5B.6","8B.1","8B.2","8B.6"],"polarity":"favorable","period_fit":"These were stated federal targets and planned measures in March 2023.","ruler_attribution":"The targets and planned legislative, infrastructure, and funding measures were presented by Chancellor Olaf Scholz for the federal government.","limitations":["The source establishes announced goals and mechanisms, not completion or outcome attainment within 2023."]},{"source_id":"SRC-1fbb0a6122d90c52","start_unit":7,"end_unit":8,"fact_summary":"At the Global Solutions Summit on 12 May 2023, Scholz argued for a multipolar international order based on the UN Charter and international law, greater engagement with the Global South, expanded representation for African states in the UN Security Council and G20, and partnerships for infrastructure, food security, climate-risk protection, and equitable energy transitions.","question_ids":["2B.1","2B.7","2B.10","8B.1","8B.2","8B.9"],"polarity":"favorable","period_fit":"The speech records Scholz's stated international program during 2023.","ruler_attribution":"The commitments were stated by Olaf Scholz and included positions and initiatives attributed to Germany's federal government and G7/G20 engagement.","limitations":["The source documents programmatic commitments and announced initiatives, not their completed implementation or measurable effects."]},{"source_id":"SRC-7a1893f8bdd00da3","start_unit":5,"end_unit":7,"fact_summary":"Destatis reported that German consumer prices rose 5.9% on average in 2023, after 6.9% in 2022; food prices rose 12.4%, household energy 14.0%, and core inflation 5.1%. It also reported that government relief measures partly moderated energy inflation, while the December 2022 one-off gas and heat payment produced a temporary upward base effect in December 2023.","question_ids":["5B.8","5B.9","5B.10","6B.6"],"polarity":"mixed","period_fit":"The figures cover the full 2023 calendar year and directly describe the inflation shock affecting households.","ruler_attribution":"Destatis attributes some price effects to federal relief measures but also identifies war, crisis conditions, and comparison effects; the figures do not isolate Scholz's causal responsibility.","limitations":["The statistics measure outcomes and identified policy effects but do not assess the adequacy or distributional incidence of the government's overall response."]},{"source_id":"SRC-4a8ae56561e8b20b","start_unit":18,"end_unit":21,"fact_summary":"The Bundestag adopted the 2023 long-term-care reform. It raised the contribution rate by 0.35 percentage points from July 2023 to generate about €6.6 billion annually, increased home-care cash and in-kind benefits by 5% from January 2024, expanded support for informal carers, increased residential-care subsidies, accelerated staffing rules, created a digitalization competence center, extended an approximately €300 million digital-investment program, and differentiated contributions by number of children.","question_ids":["6B.1","6B.2","6B.3","6B.4","6B.6","6B.8","6B.9","8B.2","8B.6"],"polarity":"favorable","period_fit":"The law was adopted on 26 May 2023, with some provisions beginning in July 2023 and others scheduled for 2024-2025.","ruler_attribution":"The reform was enacted by the federal government and Bundestag during Scholz's chancellorship; the source presents the Federal Ministry of Health's account of its provisions.","limitations":["Many benefit increases and institutional measures were scheduled for later years, so 2023 outcomes are not demonstrated."]},{"source_id":"SRC-b0513b0b3118f2ac","start_unit":5,"end_unit":6,"fact_summary":"Following Hamas's 7 October 2023 attack, Scholz declared Germany's solidarity with Israel, supported Israel's right of self-defense under international law, coordinated with France, the United States, the United Kingdom, and Italy, sought support for wounded people, and used diplomatic contacts with Egypt, Turkey, Qatar, and Jordan to pursue hostage release and regional de-escalation.","question_ids":["2B.1","2B.5","2B.7","2B.10","3B.9","8B.9"],"polarity":"mixed","period_fit":"The statement was delivered on 12 October 2023 during the immediate regional crisis.","ruler_attribution":"Olaf Scholz described his own decisions and the federal government's diplomatic and support posture.","limitations":["The statement records policy and diplomatic intent; it does not establish the subsequent success of mediation, hostage-release efforts, or civilian-protection outcomes."]},{"source_id":"SRC-b0513b0b3118f2ac","start_unit":6,"end_unit":6,"fact_summary":"Scholz announced a review of all German development cooperation with the Palestinian territories, stated that no new development-cooperation funding would be made available until the review was complete, and said humanitarian assistance supplying basic food and health care to more than half the population would continue.","question_ids":["2B.5","6B.6","6B.7","8B.2","8B.9"],"polarity":"mixed","period_fit":"The decision was announced on 12 October 2023 in response to the 7 October attack.","ruler_attribution":"The policy was announced by Chancellor Olaf Scholz on behalf of the federal government.","limitations":["The source does not provide the review's findings or quantify the effects of the funding pause on civilians."]},{"source_id":"SRC-b0513b0b3118f2ac","start_unit":6,"end_unit":6,"fact_summary":"Scholz said Germany would intensify protection of Jewish and Israeli institutions, direct law-enforcement authorities to prosecute antisemitic offenses, use association and activity bans, and that the Federal Interior Ministry would ban Hamas activities in Germany and outlaw Samidoun.","question_ids":["3B.2","3B.3","3B.5","3B.7","3B.9","4B.3","8B.2","8B.6","8B.9"],"polarity":"mixed","period_fit":"These measures were announced in October 2023 after the Hamas attack and related antisemitic incidents.","ruler_attribution":"The commitments and announced bans were stated by Olaf Scholz and attributed to German federal and Länder security authorities.","limitations":["The source does not document the legality, proportionality, implementation details, or effects of each enforcement action."]},{"source_id":"SRC-733c6fe9f60018da","start_unit":24,"end_unit":25,"fact_summary":"In a 25 January 2023 Bundestag debate, Scholz's coalition defended the government's planned Leopard tank deliveries to Ukraine as the product of a difficult, necessary process of coordination with international partners, balancing Ukraine's self-defense with Germany's security; opposition speakers criticized delay, escalation risk, and the absence of a clear peace strategy.","question_ids":["2B.1","2B.3","2B.5","2B.6","2B.7","2B.10","8B.9"],"polarity":"mixed","period_fit":"The debate concerned the government's 2023 decision process on Leopard tank deliveries.","ruler_attribution":"The source reports coalition defenses of Scholz's government and opposition criticism; it does not reproduce a direct Scholz statement in the debate text.","limitations":["The source is a parliamentary news summary of competing positions and does not independently verify the government's evidence, alternatives, or later consequences."]}],"documents_with_no_material_fact":["SRC-aac444382ff3e23c","SRC-2ad01711fcd5579a","SRC-c9a772baee6a7379","SRC-8756318e20b93381","SRC-494e82585f457ff1"],"batch_limitations":["Several supplied Bundestag pages consist primarily of navigation or procedural material and contain no concrete, ruler-attributable fact relevant to the specified lenses.","The Amnesty document concerns restrictions reported in 2024-2025 and is outside the requested 2023-2023 period; it was therefore excluded.","The Bundesverfassungsgericht document concerns a Cum-Ex criminal case involving another person and does not establish a concrete fact about Olaf Scholz's conduct or decisions."]}
